headline_cluster.headline: גיוסים של 6.4 מיליארד שקל: לאן הלך הכסף של הציבור בספטמבר?
"ספטמבר האפור": מה עשו קופות הגמל וקרנות ההשתלמות בחודש החולף?

primary_source_search_status: partial: returns claim checked against Meitav's published preliminary September 2026 estimate (via ice.co.il / Meitav reports, corroborated by Israel Hayom); the 6.4B figure turned out to be MUTUAL-FUND (קרנות נאמנות) flows, not provident/study funds - primary source (TASE Maya monthly fund reports / industry aggregators) identified but not readable in this session (WebFetch blocked), and no independent outlet re-reporting 6.4B was found; every search hit for it traces back to TheMarker's own article.
clustering_note: The rank-5 headline belongs to TheMarker's monthly mutual-fund (קרנות נאמנות) flows story, not to provident/study funds. Search-result snippets of the article: 'תעשיית קרנות הנאמנות גייסה בספטמבר כ-6.4 מיליארד שקל, כמעט מחצית (3.4 מיליארד) לקרנות הכספיות'. The headline itself does not claim pension/provident funds - the mislabel is in our cluster/slug, not in the outlet's headline. Consider splitting into a separate 'mutual-fund-flows-september' story in future runs.

claims.claim_text: גיוסים של 6.4 מיליארד שקל בספטמבר (קרנות הנאמנות; לפי תקציר הכתבה כ-3.4 מיליארד מהם לקרנות כספיות)
claims.source_figure: Not independently confirmed. Primary source = monthly mutual-fund net-flow data (TASE Maya fund reports / industry aggregators), not readable here. Only related independent datapoint: Calcalist reports Altshuler Shaham mutual funds had ~200M ILS net redemptions in September 2026 (consistent with, but not corroborating, an industry-wide figure). Note: TheMarker's own headline for September 2026 provident/study funds does not cite any inflow figure.
claims.note: Figure is about mutual funds, not provident/study funds (cluster mislabel on our side, not outlet error). Primary data source located (Maya monthly fund reports) but not accessible in this session; no second outlet re-reporting 6.4B found via WebSearch. Treat as unverified, not as wrong.

claims.claim_text: "ספטמבר האפור" - קופות הגמל וקרנות ההשתלמות הניבו תשואות אפסיות בספטמבר (כותרת משנה לפי תוצאות החיפוש)
claims.source_figure: Meitav estimate: general-track provident & study funds, September 2026 average nominal (gross) return about -0.1%, range +0.2% to -0.4%; attributed to declines in most global stock markets and in Israeli government and corporate bonds. Israel Hayom: 'הקופות כמעט לא הרוויחו בספטמבר'.
claims.note: 'Near-zero' matches the -0.1% average estimate. Caveat: it is a preliminary estimate by one investment house, not final Capital Markets Authority / Gemel-Net data (those come out toward month-end). The search engine's paraphrase of the article blames US government bond declines while Meitav cites Israeli bonds and global stocks. That is causal commentary and was not judged.

note: Article bodies could not be fetched directly (themarker.com blocked by network egress policy, articles also .premium). Audited from headlines plus WebSearch-sourced context only.
